title: bot.ability.reasoning.output
description: Typed terminal from one cognition stage back to the Cognition host.

turn.description: The body's processing turn this event belongs to, counted from 1 [floppy field].

items.description: One selected modeled HSM event. Processing dispatches it to the resolved target fire-and-forget; hosts do not re-apply OutputData. Put selection rationale on reason here — not on the event payload.

examples.reason: Attention should move to that device for this turn.

anyOf.description: Stable reference used by a cognition host to resolve a target or modeled event.

target.description: Stable reference for the host-local receiver of the modeled event. Hosts may omit this when the event resolves relative to focus or a single actor.
target.title: Target

event.description: Canonical modeled HSM event name selected by cognition.
event.title: Event

data.description: Optional typed domain payload for the selected event. Model and learned-behavior JSON projections omit raw media. Do not put selection rationale here — use reason on this envelope.
data.title: Data

reason.description: Optional reason this event was selected.
examples: Attention should move to that device for this turn.
reason.title: Reason

items.title: EventData

items.description:
One selected event to dispatch.

``confidence`` / ``meta`` hold model-facing patch values lifted by ``unpatch_event_data``
(not domain event data). ``meta`` is the full patch map; ``confidence`` is a convenience
when the active patch includes that field (0–100 integer scale). Selection rationale is
``reason`` on this envelope — not on the event payload.
items.title: SelectedEvent

output.description: Selected modeled events for Processing to dispatch fire-and-forget, or None when the stage selected nothing. Hosts do not re-apply OutputData; selection rationale belongs on each selection envelope, not here.
output.title: Output

input.description: Live body input for this turn: the stimulus plus the abilities, named actors, and focus candidates the stage may select from. Built by the Cognition host from live body context.

focus.description: Instance name the bot is looking at, if any.
focus.title: Focus

focus_candidates.description: Instance names that may become focus for this turn (body attention policy).
focus_candidates.title: Focus Candidates

input.title: InputData
